title: bin/cairn.py runs a CAIRN_BUS_MOUTH script through the shebang resolver, so a typed word reaches the mouth on Windows
intention: bin/cairn.py's _bus launches the CAIRN_BUS_MOUTH override the way it launches any script (_argv_for), so a typed word with no script reaches the mouth and returns its exit code on Windows as on Linux.
why: Measured 2026-11-20 on akiendell: bin/proofs/test_a_word_with_no_script_goes_onto_the_bus.py clause_3 and bin/proofs/test_the_launcher_reads_the_bin_beside_the_code.py clause_3 read RED with rc=70 and 'OSError: [WinError 193] %1 is not a valid Win32 application'. bin/cairn.py _bus calls subprocess.call([mouth, bus_name, *args]) on the override, while _run goes through _argv_for. The behaviour claimed (a typed word goes onto the bus and its exit code returns) is one the Windows launcher should also have, so this is a Windows defect, not host-bound.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured); Law 9 (red measures distance from the spec: the Windows launcher should carry what the Linux one does, outline 5.4.3.8).
how: In _bus, build the override's argv with _argv_for(Path(mouth)) (exit 126 with a loud line when it returns None); keep the plain call for the default Python mouth. A red-first proof runs a shebang stub mouth through bin/cairn.py as a subprocess and reads its argv log and exit code.

clauses.claim: with CAIRN_BUS_MOUTH naming a shebang script, a typed word with no script reaches that script with argv [device, word, args...] and bin/cairn.py exits the script's code, on Windows and Linux; test_a_word_with_no_script_goes_onto_the_bus clause_3 and test_the_launcher_reads_the_bin_beside_the_code a_word_in_no_bin_goes_to_the_bus (the same WinError 193 at the mouth launch) read green on Windows
with CAIRN_BUS_MOUTH naming a script no shell on PATH can run, bin/cairn.py exits 126 and names the script, never WinError 193 or exit 70

decisions.text: D2: the red-first proof, one tooth per clause.

out: the two clause_3 teeth that cite it, which stay red until it lands

measured.saw: both clause_3 teeth: rc=70, OSError WinError 193 at the mouth launch; clauses 1, 2 and 4 pass on the same host
